extDescription.message: Track your AI usage and get advice on models, privacy and avoiding unnecessary computation.

keyTitle.message: An access key in your message

keyText.message: $1 can receive your draft even before you send it. Remove the key, then change it to be safe.

dataTitle_card.message: This message contains a card number

dataTitle_ssn.message: This message contains a social security number

dataTitle_emails.message: This message contains several email addresses

dataTextOne.message: Is this information necessary for the answer? If not, replace it with an example before sending.

dataTextMany.message: Is this information necessary for the answer? If not, replace it with examples before sending.

refText.message: AI models sometimes make up sources or legal articles that look real. Open every link before you reuse it.

pastedTitle.message: This text is already in the conversation

pastedText.message: If this text is still accessible in the chat, point to the relevant passage instead of pasting it again. Otherwise include only the required excerpt.

longText.message: Your latest message may carry previous exchanges from the start of the chat. A long history can require more computation, although the provider may reuse or summarise parts of it.

longNote.message: The summary request goes into the message box. Then paste the answer into a new conversation.

summaryPrompt.message: Summarize our conversation in ten lines, so I can pick it up in a new conversation.

thanksText.message: You can include your thanks with your next request. A separate message can trigger another reply and additional computation.

trainingText_chatgpt.message: Check conversation-use settings in your account. Rules depend on your account and subscription.

trainingText.message: Check conversation-use settings in $1. Rules depend on your account and subscription.

trainingNote.message: Optidome processes messages locally. Your assistant’s website also has access to its input field.

newConvText.message: A new chat avoids carrying the old history. Keep useful information if you are continuing the same work.

keyRemovedText.message: The key is no longer in your message. Remember to change it if it was already sent.

dataRemovedText.message: Your message no longer contains this data.

noGradeYet.message: Your grade will appear after about ten messages this month.

pedagogy.message: To write each answer, the AI rereads the whole conversation from the start. The longer it gets, the more work for its servers, with a financial and environmental cost.

gradeExplain.message: The grade counts your messages sent in a conversation that is too long, meaning the AI has to reread the equivalent of about 75 pages to answer you. A: under 10% of your messages. B: under 25%. C: under 40%. D: under 60%. E: 60% and over.

notePhraseNone.message: None of your messages went into a conversation that was too long.

notePhrase.message: $1 of your messages went into a conversation that was too long.

keepItUp.message: Keep opening a new conversation for each topic.

toReachText.message: open a new conversation when you change topic.

costBefore.message: For a company using the same models, these messages would have cost

calcText.message: Public prices of the models closest to the ones your assistants use, $1, recorded on $2 and converted at the rate of $3 (€1 = $$$4). The range accounts for two things. The count is approximate, within 15%. And a company pays less for what the model rereads from a conversation already under way. The figure is still a minimum, because the instructions each assistant adds to your messages are not counted.

shareGrade.message: Share my grade for the month

noHabitsYet.message: None yet. Every tip you follow will count here.

habit_newConversation.message: New conversation at the right time

weeklyTip1.message: Say which format you want (a list, five lines, a table). You will have fewer answers to redo.

weeklyTip2.message: When you change topic, open a new conversation. The AI won't have to reread everything before it.

weeklyTip3.message: Give an example of what you expect. It is often clearer than a long explanation.

weeklyTip4.message: For a simple question, like a conversion or the weather, a search engine answers just as well.

dataExplain.message: The extension keeps daily totals on this computer, never the text of your messages.

shareNotePhraseNone.message: None of my messages went into a conversation that was too long.

shareNotePhrase.message: $1 of my messages went into a conversation that was too long.

shareNoHabit.message: My grade for the month on optidome

shareQuestion.message: How much does your company pay for all this?

analysisOptional.message: Optional. The model only runs after you click Analyse.

analysisTooLong.message: Draft too long for local analysis

analysisIntro.message: Get a suggestion for a model type and reasoning level suited to your request.

analysisSnapshot.message: A copy of your draft at the time of your click. Editing it here does not change the chat.

analysisPaste.message: Paste the request you want to analyse. Nothing will be sent to your chat.

analysisContext.message: This request needs previous messages, files or images to be understood.

analysisLoading.message: Loading the local model… The first analysis takes longer.

analysisDone.message: Analysis complete. Your model and draft are unchanged.

analysisCancelled.message: Analysis cancelled. The model has been unloaded.

analysisError.message: Local analysis is unavailable. Try again, or use the complete extension package with its model files.

analysisReason_quick.message: This request resembles a direct transformation or a simple writing task. A fast mode may be sufficient.

analysisReason_standard.message: This request resembles explanation, drafting or routine code. Start with a general-purpose mode and check the answer.

analysisReason_deep.message: This request resembles tasks involving several reasoning steps, constraints or difficult diagnosis. A reasoning mode may help.

analysisReason_short.message: Add the actual task and expected result before asking for a suggestion.

analysisReason_long.message: This request exceeds the small model’s analysis limit. It has not been shortened silently. Analyse a self-contained task description instead.

analysisReason_context.message: This analyser only sees the text shown here. Without the necessary context, recommending a lower level would be unreliable.

analysisReason_uncertain.message: The request does not match the examples clearly enough. This experimental analyser prefers not to recommend a level.

analysisReason_stakes.message: The request may concern a consequential decision. A superficial resemblance to an easy task is not enough to recommend a lower level.

analysisModel_quick.message: In your model menu: look for a fast model or a light reasoning setting, if available.

analysisModel_standard.message: In your model menu: start with a general-purpose model or the standard setting.

analysisModel_deep.message: In your model menu: consider a reasoning model or an extended setting, if available.

analysisNoChange.message: Keep your current choice, or clarify the request and try again.

analysisNote_stakes.message: More reasoning does not guarantee correctness. Important decisions still need suitable verification.

analysisNote_sources.message: Current facts and references require access to sources; increasing reasoning alone does not provide it.

analysisLimits.message: An experimental comparison with example requests, using multilingual MiniLM (118 MB of weights). It has not been validated against the answers of ChatGPT or other assistants. It sees neither your available models nor attachments or chat history. Short requests only (128 model tokens). No accuracy percentage is claimed. Model names and reasoning levels differ by service and plan.

analysisHide.message: Hide the suggestion button in chats (this tool stays available from the extension popup).

analysisPrivacy.message: Optional and offline. No request is sent to a server or saved. The model starts only when you click Analyse and is unloaded after one idle minute or when this window closes.
